title: Smart Data Models - Brick Schema - Equipment
description: A physical piece of equipment in a building's mechanical, electrical or IT systems: an air handling unit, chiller, pump, VAV box, thermostat, network device, etc. (brick:Equipment and its subclasses, Brick Schema). Modeled generically -- see the brickClass property -- rather than as hundreds of separate entity types.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Equipment'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

name.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/name'. Human-readable label (rdfs:label in the source).

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

brickClass.description: Relationship. The specific Brick class of this equipment (e.g. https://brickschema.org/schema/Brick#Rooftop_Unit). Brick's Equipment hierarchy has 331 leaf classes -- modeled generically here, as for Point.

hasPoint.description: Relationship. The Point(s) exposed by this equipment (brick:hasPoint). NOTE: the real example this was translated from (examples/iaq_sensor_deployment in the Brick GitHub repository) inconsistently uses a term 'brick:hosts' for this same relationship on some equipment instances -- 'brick:hosts' does not exist in the released Brick v1.4.4 ontology (nor does its claimed inverse, 'brick:isHostedBy'); this candidate uses 'hasPoint', which is the real, valid Brick term, used correctly elsewhere in the same example file.

hasPart.description: Relationship. Other Equipment that is a physical part of this equipment (brick:hasPart), e.g. an air filter that is part of a rooftop unit.

feeds.description: Relationship. Other Equipment or a Location that this equipment feeds air, water or energy to (brick:feeds).

isFedBy.description: Relationship. Other Equipment that feeds air, water or energy to this equipment (brick:isFedBy, the documented inverse of feeds). Not present in this candidate's own example.json instance (rtu, which is upstream in its air-chain and has nothing feeding it) -- exemplified richly and reciprocally with feeds elsewhere in the source repository, in examples/chiller-system/chiller-plant.ttl (e.g. a Chiller isFedBy several Chilled_Water_Pump and Condenser_Water_Pump instances).
